statements.t: The Company plans to return $1.0 billion to shareholders through share repurchases and approximately $407 million through common stock dividends in 2026, as part of its previously announced 2026 capital allocation plan.

The Company is also announcing its 2027 base capital allocation plan, which includes $1 billion of debt reduction, $1 billion of share repurchases and an 8% increase in the annual common dividend to $2.05 per share, consistent with the Company’s 7–9% long-term dividend growth target.
The Company expects to provide updated 2027 financial guidance and an updated capital allocation plan following the closing of the asset sale.
The timing and amount of any shares of common stock repurchased under the share repurchase authorization will be determined by NRG’s management based on market conditions and other factors.
The Company's previously disclosed 1.2 GW BYOP project remains on track.
